tasks.title: Temporary fencing, hoardings and gates
tasks.task: Erect temporary fencing, hoardings and gates: set out, deliver and erect fence panels, shade cloth and solid hoardings, ballast them for wind, and move them as the work stages change.

tasks.title: Site sheds and amenities: deliver, place, connect and remove
tasks.task: Site sheds and amenities: deliver the site sheds and containers, lift them into place with the crane crew, stack them with stairs and landings, connect services, and later remove the site sheds.

tasks.title: Gantries and overhead protection over footpaths
tasks.task: Erect and dismantle the gantry over the public footpath, lift the gantry deck units into place, and install the edge protection and lighting on the gantry, with a footpath closure.

tasks.title: Traffic management on public roads
tasks.task: Traffic management on public roads: set up, check and remove signs and devices to the approved traffic guidance scheme, lane and footpath closures, traffic controllers, night work and traffic switches.

tasks.title: Site traffic and plant movement management
tasks.task: Run the vehicle management plan inside the site: gate control, spotters, separating plant and people, exclusion zones and delivery loading zones.

tasks.title: Internal strip-out (soft strip)
tasks.task: Internal strip-out (soft strip) once the services are made safe: strip out ceilings, partitions, floor coverings and joinery, remove redundant services, and load waste into skips and bins.

tasks.title: Building demolition: roof removal, machine demolition and load-out
tasks.task: Building demolition: strip the roof sheets and timbers, demolish the structure by hand and by excavator or high reach machine, protect neighbours, control dust and noise, and load out the waste into skips and trucks.

tasks.title: Partial demolition and structural alterations in existing buildings
tasks.task: Partial demolition in an existing building that stays in use: install temporary support to the engineer's design, remove walls, cut an opening in a load-bearing wall, and demolish parts of the structure.

tasks.title: Non-friable asbestos removal (Class B)
tasks.task: Remove non-friable asbestos (Class B): fibre cement sheeting, eaves, vinyl and adhesives, removed whole by wet methods with hand tools, bagged and labelled, with decontamination and clearance before the area reopens. Includes asbestos cement roof sheets removed from the roof.

tasks.title: Friable asbestos removal (Class A) in an enclosure
tasks.task: Remove friable asbestos (Class A) lagging, sprayed insulation and low density board by wet methods inside a sealed enclosure under negative pressure, with air monitoring and clearance by an independent licensed assessor.
gaps: building and smoke testing the enclosure and the decontamination unit

tasks.title: Asbestos in soil, pits and ducts
tasks.task: Remove asbestos cement pits and ducts and asbestos contaminated soil: wet the ground, remove the soil in sections, monitor dust, and dispose of the waste.
gaps: removing asbestos contaminated soil in sections with wetting and dust monitoring

tasks.title: Hazardous materials survey and sampling
tasks.task: Hazardous materials survey before refurbishment or demolition: inspect ceilings, roof spaces, plant rooms and roofs, and take samples of suspect materials.
gaps: taking destructive samples of suspect materials and sealing the sample points

tasks.title: Lead paint, SMF and PCB removal
tasks.task: Remove lead paint by wet methods inside containment, remove synthetic mineral fibre insulation, and strip out old light fittings with PCB capacitors, before refurbishment or demolition.
gaps: removing PCB capacitors and oils from old light fittings as hazardous waste
removing synthetic mineral fibre insulation as hazardous waste

tasks.title: Fixed scaffold: erect, alter and dismantle (modular and tube and coupler)
tasks.task: Erect, alter and dismantle the fixed scaffold (modular and tube and coupler): base out, erect the scaffold lift by lift with advance guardrails, ties, loading bays and containment, inspect and hand over, and dismantle the scaffold.

tasks.title: Hung, cantilevered and suspended scaffolds, including swing stages
tasks.task: Hung and suspended scaffolds: erect the hung scaffold from the structure, and rig, inspect and dismantle the swing stage for other trades.
gaps: rigging needles, counterweights and suspension ropes
hung scaffold from the structure

tasks.title: Birdcage and load-bearing support scaffolds
tasks.task: Support scaffolds: erect and dismantle the birdcage scaffold and support scaffold under formwork decks and voids, and erect the falsework and shores to the design.
leaveOut: Load ply onto the deck while it is being laid
Monitor the formwork during the pour
gaps: a birdcage scaffold and the loading hold point for a support scaffold

tasks.title: Builders' hoists: install, climb and dismantle
tasks.task: Install, climb and dismantle the builders hoist: hoist base and mast, ties to the slab edges, landing gates and commissioning, by licensed riggers.

tasks.title: Builders' hoist operation
tasks.task: Operate the builders hoist: drive the personnel and materials hoist, load limits, landing gates and daily checks, and move bins and materials between floors.

tasks.title: Temporary edge protection, stair towers and safety nets
tasks.task: Install and remove temporary edge protection at slab and roof edges and voids, temporary stair towers, and safety nets and static lines, with inspections.

tasks.title: Mast climbing work platforms: install and dismantle
tasks.task: Mast climbing work platforms: install the base and mast, tie it in, climb and extend, inspect, and dismantle.
gaps: installing, climbing and dismantling a mast climbing work platform

tasks.title: Mobile and crawler crane lifting
tasks.task: Mobile and crawler crane lifting: travel and set up the mobile crane, check the ground and outriggers, plan and rig the lifts, lift, dog and land loads, and pack up.

tasks.title: Tower crane erection, climbing and dismantling
tasks.task: Erect and dismantle the tower crane on its engineered base with an assist crane, by the supplier's erection crew.
gaps: climbing the tower crane (jacking, adding sections and collar ties)

tasks.title: Tower crane operation and dogging
tasks.task: Tower crane operation and dogging: daily checks, lift planning, anti-collision zoning, radio signalling, slinging and landing loads at the floors, wind limits, and leaving the tower crane unattended.

tasks.title: Crawler crane assembly and dismantling
tasks.task: Assemble and dismantle the crawler crane: boom sections, tracks and counterweights with an assist crane, pinning and unpinning the boom, and testing before the first lift.

tasks.title: Dual and heavy lifts under an engineered lift plan
tasks.task: Plan and carry out a dual crane lift and heavy lifts under an engineered lift plan, with a rigging coordinator, crane mats and ground checks.

tasks.title: Vehicle loading cranes and crane trucks
tasks.task: Vehicle loading crane (crane truck) work: set up the outriggers, load and unload materials, and lift the portable building onto its footings.

tasks.title: Rigging: loading platforms, chain blocks and moving plant on skates
tasks.task: Rigging: install, move and sign off loading platforms, and move heavy plant into the plant rooms.
gaps: chain blocks and lifting beams
jacking and skating heavy plant

tasks.title: Lifting people in a crane workbox
tasks.task: Lift people in a crane workbox, only where an EWP cannot be used: lift with the mobile crane under a permit, with a registered workbox, harnesses, a wind limit and a rescue plan.
gaps: working from a crane workbox (permit, free-fall lock, wind limit and rescue)

tasks.title: Site clearing, grubbing and topsoil stripping
tasks.task: Site clearing: remove trees and stumps, clear and grub the vegetation, strip the topsoil and stockpile and cover it, inside the approved clearing footprint.
gaps: fauna spotters and stopping work for cultural heritage finds

tasks.title: Bulk earthworks: cut, fill and compaction
tasks.task: Bulk earthworks: cut and fill with excavators, dozers, scrapers and trucks, compact the fill with rollers and a rolling impact compactor, trim the batters, and stockpile and cart away spoil.

tasks.title: Detailed excavation for footings, pits and pile caps
tasks.task: Detailed excavation for pad and strip footings, pile caps, pits and trenches with smaller excavators, including excavations deeper than 1.5 m, then hand trim the base.
gaps: hand trimming and compacting the base and spreading blinding

tasks.title: Trenching for services, including trenches deeper than 1.5 m
tasks.task: Trenching for services, including trenches deeper than 1.5 m: excavate the trench, shore it or use a trench shield, lay the pipes or conduits, backfill and compact in layers, and reinstate the surface. Includes shallow trenches dug by hand.

tasks.title: Locating and exposing services by potholing or vacuum excavation
tasks.task: Locate underground services: electronic location, potholing by hand and vacuum excavation with a hydro or air vacuum truck, then mark and protect the exposed services.

tasks.title: Rock breaking and ripping
tasks.task: Rock breaking with an excavator mounted hydraulic hammer and ripping with a dozer, with exclusion zones for flying fragments, silica dust, and vibration near structures and services.

tasks.title: Spoil haulage, stockpiles and tipping
tasks.task: Spoil haulage: load trucks and truck and dogs, stockpile and cover spoil, haul the loads to the tip or reuse site, and handle contaminated or unknown material in the spoil when it is found.

tasks.title: Ground improvement: soft spot replacement, impact rolling and lime or cement treatment
tasks.task: Ground improvement: compact the fill with a rolling impact compactor, and spread and mix lime or cement into the subgrade with road plant.
gaps: digging out and replacing soft spots

tasks.title: Erosion and sediment controls
tasks.task: Install, maintain and remove erosion and sediment controls: silt fences, sediment basins, diversion drains, check dams and shake down grids at the site exit.
gaps: installing and maintaining silt fences, sediment basins, check dams and shake down grids

tasks.title: Floating, loading and unloading plant
tasks.task: Float plant between sites: load and unload plant on floats, low loaders and tilt trays, chain it down, and haul the loads.
gaps: driving plant on and off a float or low loader (ramps, winching and chaining down)

tasks.title: Earthworks in or next to waterways and creek crossings
tasks.task: Earthworks in and next to a creek: plant working on the creek banks, build the temporary bridge or causeway across the creek, with rescue from water and sediment and fuel kept out of the water.
gaps: building a temporary creek crossing or causeway on fill

tasks.title: Basement bulk excavation and truck loading
tasks.task: Basement bulk excavation: dig out the basement in stages inside the retention wall, build and keep the haul ramp, load trucks with a spotter, protect the basement edge and the access into the basement, protect neighbouring buildings and the footpath, and stockpile and cart away spoil.

tasks.title: Staged excavation with ground anchors, props and shoring
tasks.task: Staged basement excavation: excavate in front of the retention wall to each design stage level, stop until the ground anchors are stressed or the props are installed, never dig out soil above the anchors without approval, monitor the wall, and remove the props in the reverse sequence.
leaveOut: Install and later remove ground anchors

tasks.title: Detailed excavation in the basement: pile caps, lift pits, sumps and footings
tasks.task: Detailed excavation in the basement: dig the pile caps, lift pits, sumps and footings with small excavators, shore or batter anything deeper than 1.5 m, protect the pile heads and starter bars, and fit lockable covers to the lift pits.

tasks.title: Dewatering the excavation
tasks.task: Dewater the basement excavation: install and run spear points, wells and sump pumps, treat and discharge the water under the permit, watch for boiling and piping in sandy ground, and keep a flooding emergency plan.

tasks.title: Contaminated fill, acid sulfate soils and spoil classification
tasks.task: Contaminated fill and acid sulfate soils: dig and stockpile contaminated or unknown fill under the management plan, sample and classify the spoil before disposal, monitor gas in the excavation, stop and report suspect material found in the fill, and wash down the trucks.

tasks.title: Rock excavation in basements: hammering, rock sawing and ripping next to neighbours
tasks.task: Rock excavation in the basement: break rock with hydraulic hammers, saw and rip the rock next to neighbouring buildings, with vibration monitoring, silica dust controls and checks on the rock faces.
gaps: rock sawing
vibration monitoring at neighbouring buildings

tasks.title: Underpinning neighbouring footings
tasks.task: Underpinning: hand excavate the underpinning pits one at a time under the neighbouring footing, install temporary support in each pit, place mass concrete, and protect and monitor the neighbouring building.
gaps: excavating and shoring underpinning pits under a neighbouring footing

tasks.title: Stormwater drainage: pipes, pits and subsoil drains
tasks.task: Stormwater drainage: excavate trenches, including trenches deeper than 1.5 m with shoring or shields, lay and joint the pipes and subsoil drain pipes, place the precast pits and gully pits, and backfill and compact.

tasks.title: Gravity sewer mains and manholes
tasks.task: Gravity sewer mains: excavate deep trenches with shoring or shields, lay sewer pipe to grade, place precast manholes, fusion weld PE pipe, and backfill.
gaps: building a manhole in place (formwork, benching and a cast in situ shaft)

tasks.title: Connections to live sewers and work in existing manholes
tasks.task: Connect to the live sewer main and enter existing manholes as a confined space, with gas testing.
gaps: bypass pumping and flow control

tasks.title: Water mains: lay, test, disinfect and connect
tasks.task: Water mains: excavate the trench, lay PE and PVC mains, butt and electrofusion weld the pipe, and pressure test the main.
gaps: disinfecting (chlorinating) the main
thrust blocks and valve chambers

tasks.title: Live water main connections and shutdowns
tasks.task: Live water main connection: plan the shutdown and connect the new water main to the live main.
gaps: authority shutdowns, under pressure tapping and recharging the main

tasks.title: Pump stations, wet wells and valve chambers
tasks.task: Pump stations: excavate for the wet well, place the precast wet well and valve chambers, install the new pump station pumps and pipework, and enter the well as a confined space.

tasks.title: Culverts and headwalls
tasks.task: Culverts and headwalls in a creek with a risk of drowning: place the precast culvert units by crane, form the headwalls and wingwalls, place rock scour protection, and backfill.
gaps: placing box culvert units in line and their joints
headwall forming

tasks.title: Trenchless crossings: directional drilling, boring and pipe jacking
tasks.task: Trenchless crossings: horizontal directional drilling from launch and receive pits, drilling fluid handling and pullback of the pipe.
gaps: thrust boring, pipe jacking and microtunnelling

tasks.title: Pipe relining, cleaning and CCTV inspection
tasks.task: Drain cleaning and pipe relining: jet and clear the drains, CCTV inspection, and reline the pipes from pits or manholes.

tasks.title: Stormwater basins, open channels and swales
tasks.task: Stormwater basins and channels: excavate and shape the basin batters with earthmoving plant, line them with geomembrane, and place rock armour scour protection, with a risk of drowning when the basin holds water.

tasks.title: Subgrade preparation and proof rolling
tasks.task: Subgrade preparation: trim and compact the subgrade with graders, rollers and water carts, proof roll, and spread and compact gravel.
gaps: trimming to level and proof rolling

tasks.title: Granular pavement layers: sub-base and base
tasks.task: Granular pavement: deliver, spread and compact the sub-base and base gravel in layers with road plant.
gaps: grader trimming to level and layer testing

tasks.title: Pavement stabilisation (lime, cement or foamed bitumen)
tasks.task: Pavement stabilisation next to live traffic: spread lime or cement and mix it in place with the stabiliser and road plant, then roll it.
gaps: the spreader and stabiliser run
foamed bitumen stabilisation

tasks.title: Asphalt paving
tasks.task: Asphalt paving: spray tack coat, trucks feeding the paver, lay and roll the asphalt, and hand work, with burns, fumes and plant controls.

tasks.title: Asphalt profiling (milling)
tasks.task: Asphalt profiling next to live traffic: mill the existing road surface with a profiler loading trucks, and sweep.
gaps: running the profiler (milling machine)

tasks.title: Sprayed bitumen sealing
tasks.task: Sprayed bitumen sealing: prime, primerseal and two coat seals with a bitumen sprayer, aggregate spreader and rollers.

tasks.title: Concrete road pavement (slipform paving)
tasks.task: Concrete road pavement: place and finish the concrete pavement on the ground, and saw cut the joints.
gaps: slipform paving

tasks.title: Concrete kerb and channel
tasks.task: Kerb and channel: prepare the base, form and pour the kerb and channel with a kerb machine, and finish the concrete.
gaps: preparing the kerb base and saw cutting the kerb joints

tasks.title: Concrete footpaths, shared paths and driveways
tasks.task: Concrete footpaths and shared paths: close the footpath, prepare the base, place the mesh, place and finish the concrete, and saw cut joints, next to the public.

tasks.title: Saw cutting and pavement reinstatement
tasks.task: Saw cutting and reinstatement: saw cut asphalt and concrete in live roads and paths, break out, and reinstate the asphalt patches.

tasks.title: Line marking and raised pavement markers
tasks.task: Road line marking: remove old markings, paint lines, lay thermoplastic with a gas torch, and fix raised pavement markers, under traffic.

tasks.title: Road safety barrier, signs and guide posts
tasks.task: Road furniture: install the road safety barrier, sign posts and signs, guide posts and bollards, after locating services.
gaps: driving barrier and sign posts

tasks.title: Noise walls
tasks.task: Noise walls: bore the footings, stand the posts, and lift in the noise wall panels with a crane, next to traffic.
gaps: large diameter bored footings for noise wall posts

tasks.title: Road line marking and raised pavement markers
tasks.task: Road line marking: set out and paint lines from the line marking truck or by hand on the road, lay thermoplastic with a gas torch, and fix raised pavement markers, under the traffic management plan.

tasks.title: Car park, warehouse and sports court marking
tasks.task: Line marking in car parks, warehouses and sports courts, separated from forklifts and vehicles by barriers, with solvent and ventilation controls indoors.

tasks.title: Line marking removal by grinding or water blasting
tasks.task: Remove old line marking by grinding with extraction or with a water blasting truck, with exclusion zones and slurry collection.

tasks.title: Tactile ground surface indicators and anti-slip
tasks.task: Install tactile ground surface indicators and anti-slip treatments on footpaths, stairs and platforms, with silica and adhesive controls.

tasks.title: Gabion walls
tasks.task: Gabion walls: excavate the footing, build and fill the gabion baskets, place filled baskets by crane, install wall drainage, and backfill and compact behind the wall.

tasks.title: Segmental block, concrete sleeper and reinforced soil walls
tasks.task: Segmental block and concrete sleeper retaining walls: excavate the cut, build the block retaining wall or concrete sleeper wall, install wall drainage, and backfill and compact.
gaps: geogrid reinforcement layers for reinforced soil walls

tasks.title: Cast in situ concrete retaining walls
tasks.task: Cast in situ concrete retaining walls: form the retaining wall base and stem, fix the reo, pour the wall with a boom pump, strip, install wall drainage and backfill.

tasks.title: Precast concrete retaining walls and reinforced earth panels
tasks.task: Precast retaining walls: place the precast L units and wall panels with the crane crew, prop them, and backfill and compact behind the wall.
gaps: reinforced earth straps and fill layers

tasks.title: Soil nailing and shotcrete walls
tasks.task: Soil nail walls: drill the soil nails with the drill rig, mix and pump the grout, and spray shotcrete to the cut face in lifts over mesh, with drainage strips behind.

tasks.title: Ground anchors and rock bolts
tasks.task: Ground anchors and rock bolts: drill, install and grout the ground anchors, stress and lock off, and later de-stress temporary anchors.

tasks.title: Crib walls
tasks.task: Crib walls: build the crib retaining wall from concrete crib units, with wall drainage and backfill behind the wall.
gaps: laying concrete crib units and filling and compacting inside the cribs

tasks.title: Rock walls and rock armour
tasks.task: Rock walls: select and place large rocks with an excavator for the rock wall and batter protection, with no one between the rock and the machine.

tasks.title: Bridge substructure: footings, pile caps, abutments and wingwalls
tasks.task: Bridge substructure: excavate the pile caps and footings, including excavations deeper than 1.5 m, set the edge forms and place and tie the reo for the footings and pile caps, form, reo and pour the abutment and wingwall retaining walls, and pump and place the concrete.

tasks.title: Piers, columns and headstocks
tasks.task: Bridge piers, columns and headstocks: erect the column and headstock formwork and falsework, lift in the reo cages, and pour the concrete from access platforms at height.
gaps: standing and bracing column and headstock formwork

tasks.title: Girder erection: precast concrete or steel girders
tasks.task: Bridge girder erection: land precast concrete or steel girders onto the bearings with one or two cranes, with temporary restraint and bracing, cross bracing and diaphragms.
gaps: landing girders on bearings with temporary restraint

tasks.title: Bridge deck: deck units or formwork, reo and pour
tasks.task: Bridge deck: land and fix the precast deck planks or erect the deck formwork, fix the reinforcement, and pump and place the deck concrete.
gaps: deck forms and edge protection on girders over traffic or water

tasks.title: Bridge bearings: install and replace
tasks.task: Bridge bearings: jack the bridge superstructure, replace the bearings and lower it.
gaps: setting and grouting new bearings

tasks.title: Bridge barriers, parapets and expansion joints
tasks.task: Bridge barriers and expansion joints: install the barrier and parapet units at the deck edge and replace the expansion joints on the bridge.
gaps: barrier and parapet installation at an open bridge deck edge
installing and replacing expansion joints

tasks.title: Post-tensioning of bridge elements
tasks.task: Post-tensioning of bridge elements: install the ducts and strand, stress the tendons, grout the ducts and cut the tails, with exclusion zones behind the jack.

tasks.title: Bridge work over or next to water
tasks.task: Bridge work over and next to water, from barges, pontoons and work boats, with rescue boats and life jackets, a flood watch, and concrete, fuel and sediment kept out of the water.
gaps: temporary work platforms and cofferdams over water

tasks.title: Temporary bridges, falsework towers and working platforms
tasks.task: Build and remove the temporary bridge and erect falsework towers to the temporary works design, with inspections and hold points before loading.
leaveOut: Load ply onto the deck while it is being laid
Monitor the formwork during the pour
gaps: falsework towers for bridges

tasks.title: Bridge maintenance and repair over traffic or rail
tasks.task: Bridge maintenance over a road open to traffic: concrete repairs, abrasive blasting and painting of the bridge, working above traffic.
gaps: access by an under bridge inspection unit or hanging scaffold

tasks.title: Rail safeworking and track protection (protection officer)
tasks.task: Rail safeworking: plan access to the rail corridor, set up the protection, grant and hand back the work site, and provide lookouts and warnings for the crews in the corridor.
gaps: the protection officer's own work: setting up the protection, and granting and handing back the work site

tasks.title: Track construction: sleepers, rail, ballast, tamping
tasks.task: Track construction in the rail corridor: lay sleepers and rail, drop ballast, and tamp and regulate the track, with silica dust controls.
gaps: laying new sleepers and rail with a track machine

tasks.title: Resleepering and ballast renewal
tasks.task: Resleepering in the rail corridor: remove old sleepers, insert new sleepers, renew the ballast and tamp, with on-track plant and silica dust controls.

tasks.title: Rail welding and stressing (aluminothermic and flash butt)
tasks.task: Rail welding in the rail corridor: cut the rail, aluminothermic welding with preheating and molten metal, grind the welds, and stress the rail with tensors.
gaps: aluminothermic and flash butt rail welding
rail stressing with tensors

tasks.title: Turnout installation and renewal
tasks.task: Turnout renewal in the rail corridor: remove the old turnout, lift in the turnout panels with the crane crew, connect, ballast and tamp the track in a possession.
gaps: lifting in and installing turnout panels

tasks.title: Road-rail (hi-rail) plant operation
tasks.task: Road-rail (hi-rail) plant in the rail corridor: on-track and off-track road-rail vehicles and excavators, travel and work on the track, and check the braking and rail gear.
gaps: on-tracking, off-tracking and travelling road-rail plant

tasks.title: Rail corridor civil works: drainage, access roads and fencing
tasks.task: Rail corridor civil works next to live track in the rail corridor: excavate cess drain trenches and pits, and build the corridor fencing.
gaps: digging next to the track tied to the danger zone and the protection arrangements

tasks.title: Level crossing renewal
tasks.task: Level crossing renewal: close and divert the road traffic, remove the crossing panels, renew the track and ballast in the rail corridor, and lay asphalt.
gaps: removing and replacing level crossing panels

tasks.title: Station platform works next to live track
tasks.task: Station platform works next to live track in the rail corridor: place the precast platform units and pour concrete for the platform extension.
gaps: work at the platform edge next to live track

tasks.title: Soft landscaping: soil, planting, mulch and turf
tasks.task: Soft landscaping: spread topsoil, plant shrubs and groundcovers, mulch and lay turf, with skid steers and small earthmoving plant.

tasks.title: Hard landscaping: paving, edging and landscape walls
tasks.task: Hard landscaping: lay and cut pavers, build garden beds and edging, and build landscape and stone retaining walls.

tasks.title: Irrigation installation
tasks.task: Irrigation: dig shallow trenches for the irrigation lines, lay and connect the pipe, controllers and valves, and plant around them.
gaps: laying irrigation pipe and fitting controllers and valves

tasks.title: Advanced and street tree planting
tasks.task: Advanced tree planting: excavate the tree pit next to the road, lift the large root ball trees in with a crane truck, plant and stake the trees.
gaps: lifting and setting large root ball trees

tasks.title: Revegetation and batter planting
tasks.task: Revegetation: plant tubestock on batters and creek lines, brush cut the weeds with a brushcutter, and work on slopes near plant and traffic.
gaps: hand held petrol augers
laying jute matting on steep batters

tasks.title: Placing soil, mulch and aggregate with a blower or slinger truck
tasks.task: Blower truck and slinger truck work: set up the truck, run the blower hose to place soil, mulch and aggregate, with exclusion zones and dust control, and pack up.

tasks.title: Podium, roof garden and green wall planting
tasks.task: Podium and roof garden planting: get soil and plants to the roof by crane, install the green roof layers and the green wall, and plant next to the edges.

tasks.title: Landscape furniture, shade structures and playgrounds
tasks.task: Install landscape furniture: seats, bike racks, bollards, shade sails and playground equipment, with their footings.

tasks.title: Piling rig delivery, assembly and working platform
tasks.task: Piling rig delivery and assembly: deliver the piling rig, assemble and dismantle the mast, check the piling platform certificate, and move the rig around the site.

tasks.title: CFA piling
tasks.task: CFA piling: drill with the continuous flight auger, pump concrete through the auger, handle the spoil, and plunge the cage into the fresh pile.

tasks.title: Bored piles with temporary casing or support fluid
tasks.task: Bored piles: drill the bore with the piling rig, protect the open bore, lift and lower the pile cages, and pour the pile concrete by tremie.
gaps: installing and extracting temporary casing
mixing and handling bentonite or polymer support fluid

tasks.title: Driven piles: precast concrete and steel
tasks.task: Driven piles: pitch precast concrete and steel piles, drive them with an impact or hydraulic hammer, splice and cut them, with noise and vibration monitoring.

tasks.title: Sheet piling: install and extract
tasks.task: Sheet piling: pitch and drive the sheet piles, install walers and props, and extract the sheet piles at the end.
gaps: vibrating sheet piles in and extracting them

tasks.title: Screw piles
tasks.task: Screw piles: install screw piles with a drive head on an excavator or small rig, monitor the torque, and cut and cap the piles.
gaps: installing screw piles

tasks.title: Secant, contiguous and soldier pile walls
tasks.task: Pile walls: install the shoring wall of secant, contiguous or soldier piles with the piling rig, next to neighbouring buildings, then excavate in front of the retention wall.

tasks.title: Pile trimming and pile head breakdown
tasks.task: Pile trimming: expose the pile heads, crop or break down the piles, and cut the reo, with silica dust and vibration controls.

tasks.title: Pile load and integrity testing
tasks.task: Pile testing: static load tests with kentledge or reaction piles and jacks, dynamic testing with a drop weight, and integrity testing.
gaps: pile load and integrity testing

tasks.title: Ground improvement with a rig: stone columns, rigid inclusions and wick drains
tasks.task: Ground improvement with a rig: vibro stone columns, rigid inclusions and deep soil mixing columns, and wick drains.
gaps: installing wick drains with a stitcher rig

tasks.title: Marine piling from a barge or jack-up
tasks.task: Marine piling from a barge: work from the barge over water, pitch and drive the piles, install pile jackets and grout them.

tasks.title: Suspended slab and beam formwork: erect, strip and backprop
tasks.task: Suspended slab formwork: erect the falsework and shores, lay the formwork deck with edge protection and penetration covers, work with the crane crew to land the packs, strip and backprop.

tasks.title: Column, wall and stair formwork
tasks.task: Column, wall and stair formwork: erect the column boxes, wall forms with ties, and stair formwork, brace the forms, and strip them after the pour.
leaveOut: Load ply onto the deck while it is being laid
gaps: standing and bracing column and wall forms, and working platforms on wall forms

tasks.title: Jumpform and self-climbing core formwork
tasks.task: Jumpform: prepare to climb, climb the jumpform hydraulically, work on the jumpform platforms, set the wall forms, and emergency and rescue on the core.

tasks.title: Perimeter safety screens: install, climb and remove
tasks.task: Perimeter safety screens: install the perimeter screens, lift them floor by floor with hydraulic lifters or the tower crane, and remove them.

tasks.title: High falsework and load-bearing support scaffold
tasks.task: High falsework: erect and dismantle the falsework and shores and the support scaffold under the decks and voids, to the temporary works design.
leaveOut: Load ply onto the deck while it is being laid
gaps: a load-bearing support scaffold to a temporary works design, with its hold point before loading

tasks.title: Formwork for footings, ground slabs and edges
tasks.task: Formwork for footings and ground slabs: edge forms, footing and pile cap forms, set downs, dowels and joints at ground level, with nail guns and saws.

tasks.title: Reinforcement to footings, pile caps, ground slabs and pits

tasks.task: Hoist the lift machine, rails and equipment into the lift shaft and machine room with chain blocks, working at open lift shafts and landing doors.

tasks.title: Installing rails, landing doors, car and counterweight
tasks.task: Install the lift: set the lift rails, fix the landing doors, and build the lift car and counterweight in the lift shaft.

tasks.title: Car top and pit work, testing and commissioning
tasks.task: Lift car top and pit work: run the lift car on inspection control, work on the car top and in the pit with isolation, and test and commission the lift.

tasks.title: Escalators and moving walks
tasks.task: Install escalators and moving walks with the area closed.
gaps: setting the escalator truss and installing the step band

tasks.title: Lift modernisation and replacement in occupied buildings
tasks.task: Lift modernisation: strip out the old lift services, replace the lift motor, and work on the car top beside lifts still running in an occupied building.
gaps: stripping out an old car and machine beside lifts still in service

tasks.title: Platform lifts, stair lifts and dumbwaiters
tasks.task: Install platform lifts, stair lifts and dumbwaiters with their shafts or enclosures, isolation and commissioning.

tasks.title: Construction use of a lift: jump lifts and temporary cars
tasks.task: Operate the builders hoist and the jump lift for the builder while the building rises, and work inside the lift cars.
gaps: raising a jump lift's machine platform

tasks.title: Metal roof sheeting, safety mesh, blanket and flashings
tasks.task: Metal roofing: roof access and edge protection, lift bundles to the roof, fix safety mesh and insulation blanket, cut and fix the roof sheets and flashings, and install the gutters.

tasks.title: Re-roofing and roof sheet replacement on existing buildings
tasks.task: Re-roofing: check the existing roof for fragile sheets and skylights, cover skylights and openings, strip the old roof sheets in sections, replace purlins where needed, and re-sheet the roof.

tasks.title: Metal wall cladding
tasks.task: Metal wall cladding: fix girts and metal wall cladding sheets to the building from an EWP.
gaps: long metal wall sheets handled at height in wind

tasks.title: Skylights, roof penetrations and plant flashings
tasks.task: Skylights and roof penetrations: cut in skylights with roof access and edge protection, flash services and plant penetrations, and cover or fence openings while they are open.

tasks.title: Permanent roof safety systems: guardrail, walkways, anchors and static lines
tasks.task: Permanent roof safety systems: install permanent roof anchors and static lines, roof guardrail and edge protection, and walkways and platforms on the roof.
gaps: permanent roof walkways and platforms

tasks.title: Unitised curtain wall installation
tasks.task: Unitised curtain wall: receive the facade panels lifted to the floors, move the panels to the face, set up the floor crane, fix brackets at the slab edge, and install and seal the panels from inside, with glass handled in wind.

tasks.title: Stick curtain wall, glazed walls and shopfront framing
tasks.task: Stick curtain wall and shopfront framing: install window frames, mullions and transoms, glaze the large glass panes with vacuum lifters, and seal the glazing, with glass handled in wind.
gaps: erecting mullions and transoms from outside on an EWP or scaffold
glazing large lites with a glazing robot or crane

tasks.title: Windows, external doors and louvres
tasks.task: Install aluminium windows, external doors and louvres: move the glass and frames to the levels, install the windows, fit the door hardware, and seal the glazing and flashings.

tasks.title: Glass balustrades and handrails at open edges
tasks.task: Install glass balustrades and handrails at balcony, void and stair edges: move the glass panels with vacuum lifters, with temporary edge protection kept until each panel is fixed.

tasks.title: Internal glazing: glazed partitions, shower screens and mirrors
tasks.task: Internal glazing: install glazed partitions, shower screens and mirrors, move the glass panels, drill tiled walls for fixings, and seal the glazing.

tasks.title: Facade cladding panels: aluminium composite, metal and fibre cement
tasks.task: Facade cladding panels: install aluminium composite, metal or fibre cement cladding panels from an EWP or scaffold, cutting panels to fit.
gaps: subframe rails and brackets
lifting large cladding panels at height

tasks.title: Facade sealing, repairs and glass replacement from a swing stage or BMU
tasks.task: Facade sealing, repairs and glass replacement from a swing stage: rig and work from the swing stage to seal facade joints and replace damaged glass, with glass handled in wind and an exclusion zone below.

tasks.title: Wet area membranes: bathrooms, kitchens and plant rooms
tasks.task: Wet area waterproofing: prepare the substrate, lay screeds to falls, apply liquid membranes to floors and walls, and flood test.

tasks.title: Balcony, podium, planter and trafficable deck membranes
tasks.task: Balcony and podium waterproofing: apply liquid membranes to balconies, podium decks and planter boxes near open edges, lay drainage cell and protection board, and flood test.

tasks.title: Roof membranes: torch-on and liquid applied
tasks.task: Roof membranes: lift the membrane rolls to the roof, prime, lay torch-on sheet membranes under a hot work permit, at the roof edge.

tasks.title: Basement tanking, lift pits and below ground walls
tasks.task: Basement tanking: prepare and prime the substrate, apply sheet and liquid membranes to below ground walls and floors, and lift pits and sumps, with confined space checks.
gaps: blindside sheet membranes fixed to retention walls before the pour
working inside lift pits and sumps

tasks.title: Pools, tanks and water retaining structures
tasks.task: Waterproof pools, balance tanks and water tanks: grind and prepare the substrate and apply liquid membranes, working inside enclosed tanks as a confined space.
gaps: applying membranes inside a tank or enclosed pit (ventilation for solvent vapours, entry and rescue)

tasks.title: Sealants, caulking and expansion joints
tasks.task: Sealants and caulking: rake out and seal movement and expansion joints, caulk between trades, and seal facade joints from a swing stage.

tasks.title: Under slab (soffit) insulation boards
tasks.task: Fix insulation boards to the slab soffit with powder-actuated tools or adhesive from EWPs and mobile scaffolds, moving the boards into place, with an exclusion zone below.

tasks.title: Wall and ceiling batts, acoustic insulation and sisalation
tasks.task: Install wall and ceiling insulation batts, sisalation and acoustic insulation in stud walls and over ceilings, moving materials into place and working from platforms.

tasks.title: Insulation in the roof space of an existing building
tasks.task: Install insulation in the roof space of an existing occupied building: power isolated before entry, walk only on joists or boards, heat stress limits, and lay or blow in the insulation.

tasks.title: Sprayed insulation: polyurethane foam and sprayed fire or thermal coatings
tasks.task: Spray polyurethane foam insulation to soffits and walls from an EWP, with isocyanate controls, ventilation and respirators.
gaps: sprayed cementitious or fibre insulation to soffits

tasks.title: Steel stud framing to walls, bulkheads and ceilings
tasks.task: Steel stud framing: set out, cut and fix steel track and studs, bulkheads and casings, drill anchors with dust extraction, fix with powder-actuated tools, and move materials into place.
gaps: flush ceiling framing: drilling hanger anchors into the slab and fixing furring channel overhead

tasks.title: Plasterboard and fibre cement linings to walls, partitions and ceilings
tasks.task: Plasterboard linings: move sheets into place with sheet trolleys and lifters, cut and fix plasterboard to walls and ceilings and wet area sheets, work from trestles and platform ladders, and sand the joints.
gaps: cutting fibre cement sheet with on-tool dust extraction

tasks.title: Setting, sanding and finishing plasterboard
tasks.task: Set and sand plasterboard: tape and set the joints and cornices, sand with dust extraction, and clean up the work area.

tasks.title: Suspended grid and acoustic tile ceilings
tasks.task: Suspended grid ceilings: drill hanger anchors into the slab with dust extraction, install the suspended grid ceilings, and lay the ceiling tiles, moving materials into place.

tasks.title: Insulated sandwich wall and ceiling panels
tasks.task: Insulated sandwich panels: move materials into place, install the cool room panels and clean room walls and ceilings, and seal the joints.
gaps: storing insulated panels, standing tall panels with a panel lifter, and cutting panels and channels on site

tasks.title: Shaft walls and fire rated walls
tasks.task: Shaft walls and fire rated walls: frame walls and fix plasterboard to the fire rated walls and shaft walls, working near voids and open lift shafts.
gaps: building a shaft wall from the floor side at an open shaft (screen removal, one panel at a time)

tasks.title: External wall framing, soffits and fibre cement facade sheeting
tasks.task: External framing: steel stud framing to the perimeter and parapets, line the eaves and soffits, and fix fibre cement cladding, working near the open slab edges.
gaps: perimeter framing at an open slab edge before the facade closes it in (edge protection taken down one bay at a time)

tasks.title: Lead-lined walls and radiation shielding
tasks.task: Lead-lined walls and radiation shielding: move and fix heavy lead-lined plasterboard and lead sheet, cut lead-lined sheets, with lead hygiene controls.

tasks.title: Door frames, doors and hardware
tasks.task: Door frames, doors and hardware: move doors and frames to the floors, stand and fix the door frames, hang the doors, and fit locks, closers and door hardware.

tasks.title: Joinery and cabinetry installation
tasks.task: Install joinery and cabinetry: move the joinery units to the floors, install kitchens, vanities, wardrobes, counters and shelving, scribe and fix them to the walls, and set the stone benchtops.

tasks.title: Fix-out: skirtings, architraves, timber linings and wall panelling
tasks.task: Carpentry fix-out: skirtings, architraves and window reveals, timber wall linings, and acoustic timber wall panels, with drop saws and nail guns.
gaps: timber ceiling linings and battens fixed overhead

tasks.title: Toilet partitions, lockers, operable walls and bathroom accessories
tasks.task: Install toilet partitions, lockers and bathroom accessories (grab rails, dispensers and mirrors), moving materials into place and drilling tiled walls for fixings.
gaps: heavy operable wall panels hung from an overhead track
standing tall partition panels

tasks.title: Timber wall, floor and roof framing
tasks.task: Timber framing: stand and brace the wall frames, lay the floor joists and floor deck, fix the roof trusses and roof battens, working near the open edges.

tasks.title: Timber stairs, handrails, screens and decking at open edges
tasks.task: Build the timber staircase and handrails, balustrade infills and screens, and lay timber decking, next to open edges, voids and the stair void.

tasks.title: Tenancy fit-out: whole shopfitting package
tasks.task: Tenancy fit-out: erect the hoardings, strip out the old ceilings, partitions and floor coverings, frame and line the partitions with plasterboard, install the joinery, and cart rubbish to the site bins.
gaps: working inside an operating centre (centre management permits, night work and the public outside the hoarding)

tasks.title: Shopfront hoarding and working in an operating centre
tasks.task: Erect and remove the shopfront hoardings, separate the public from deliveries and the work, and fix the hoarding graphics.
gaps: working in an operating shopping centre (the public, after-hours deliveries through the centre and centre permits)

tasks.title: Tenancy strip-out and make good
tasks.task: Tenancy strip-out after the services are isolated: strip out the ceilings, partitions, joinery, floor coverings and signage, load skips and bins, and make good.

tasks.title: Shopfitting joinery, counters and display units
tasks.task: Install shopfitting joinery, counters, display units and shelving: move materials into place with trolleys and team lifts, fix to walls and floors, and set the stone benchtops.

tasks.title: Tenancy partitions, ceilings and bulkheads
tasks.task: Frame and line the tenancy partitions and bulkheads with plasterboard, set and sand the joints, and install the suspended grid ceilings.

tasks.title: Shopfronts, signage and display lighting
tasks.task: Install glazed shopfronts and doors, move the glass panels into place, and install illuminated signs and bulkhead signage.
gaps: a glazed shopfront in a public mall (night install, public kept back)
heavy signs lifted onto bulkheads

tasks.title: Floor and wall tiling
tasks.task: Floor and wall tiling: move tiles to the rooms, mix adhesive and grout, cut tiles wet or with extraction, lay floor and wall tiles on acoustic matting, and work from trestles for wall tiles.

tasks.title: Floor screeds, toppings and bedding
tasks.task: Floor screeds: mix and place sand cement screeds and toppings to falls in wet areas, moving bags and materials into place.

tasks.title: Balcony, terrace and roof top tiling
tasks.task: Balcony tiling: cut and lay tiles on balconies and terraces next to open edges, with edge protection kept in place.

tasks.title: Stone and large format floor tiles
tasks.task: Stone and large format tiles: cut stone wet, lay natural stone and large format porcelain tiles, and move and set the heavy stone slabs.
gaps: handling and placing large stone slabs with a vacuum lifter

tasks.title: Pool, wet deck and coping tiling
tasks.task: Pool tiling: cut and lay tiles to the pool waterline, wet decks and copings next to the water, with drowning and slip controls when the pool holds water.
gaps: tiling inside an empty pool shell or beside a filled pool

tasks.title: Floor preparation: grinding, patching and levelling
tasks.task: Floor preparation: grind the slab with dust extraction, patch it, and pump or pour self-levelling compound, with silica dust controls.

tasks.title: Sheet vinyl, rubber and resilient flooring
tasks.task: Lay sheet vinyl and rubber flooring: move the rolls into place, spread the adhesive, lay the floor coverings, heat weld the seams and form coved skirtings.

tasks.title: Carpet and carpet tiles
tasks.task: Lay carpet and carpet tiles: move the rolls and cartons into place, spread the adhesive, and lay the carpet by direct stick or stretch laying.

tasks.title: Epoxy and polyurethane resin floor coatings
tasks.task: Epoxy floor coatings: grind and prime the slab, and apply epoxy or polyurethane floor coatings, with ventilation, isocyanate and skin sensitiser controls.

tasks.title: Timber and engineered timber floors, sanding and coating
tasks.task: Timber floors: cut and lay timber and engineered boards, and sand and coat the timber floor with dust extraction.

tasks.title: Raised access floors
tasks.task: Raised access floors: set out and install the pedestals and panels, cut panels, and keep the open floor voids barricaded around energised cables under the floor.

tasks.title: Internal painting by brush and roller
tasks.task: Internal painting: prepare, fill and sand, paint walls, ceilings, doors and trim by brush and roller, from platform ladders and trestles for high walls, and wash out at the washout bay.

tasks.title: External painting at height
tasks.task: External painting at height: paint external walls, cladding, fascias and eaves from EWPs, scaffold or a swing stage, with drop zones below and wind limits.

tasks.title: Airless spray painting and solvent-based coatings
tasks.task: Airless spray painting with solvent-based paints, with ventilation and no ignition sources, respirators, overspray protection and exclusion of other trades.

tasks.title: Preparing existing painted surfaces: lead paint, abrasive and water blasting
tasks.task: Prepare existing painted surfaces: test for lead paint and remove it by wet methods inside containment, abrasive blast and water blast the existing surfaces, and dispose of paint waste.

tasks.title: Protective coatings to steel and concrete
tasks.task: Protective coatings: abrasive blast and spray paint structural steel and concrete with solvent-based epoxy and zinc coatings.
gaps: intumescent or two pack coatings on steel at height
coating inside tanks and confined spaces

tasks.title: Builders' clean and final clean
tasks.task: Builders clean and final clean: clean internal areas, wet areas, kitchens and fittings, remove protective films and labels, mop and polish floors, and cart rubbish to the site bins.

tasks.title: Window and facade cleaning
tasks.task: Window and facade cleaning: clean the glazing inside and out from the floor and from an EWP, and clean windows from the building maintenance unit.

tasks.title: Pressure cleaning and water blasting
tasks.task: Pressure cleaning and water blasting of paving, roads and facades with high pressure water cleaners and water blasters, with exclusion zones and slurry and runoff control.

tasks.title: Acid washing and chemical removal of mortar and render
tasks.task: Acid washing: clean down the brickwork and remove cement, mortar and render stains with acid or chemical cleaners, with the builder's consent, and control splash and runoff.
leaveOut: Set up and use the brick elevator
gaps: acid washing of surfaces other than brickwork

tasks.title: Site clean-ups and waste removal during construction
tasks.task: Site clean-ups during construction: clean floors, stairs and access ways, cart rubbish to the site bins and chutes, remove hazardous waste, and clean the site amenities.

tasks.title: Using an elevating work platform (scissor lift or boom lift)
tasks.task: Use an elevating work platform (scissor lift or boom lift): pre-start checks, check the slab or ground, secure the area, harness to the boom anchor, overhead services and power lines, wind limits, emergency lowering and rescue.

tasks.title: Erecting and dismantling mobile scaffolds
tasks.task: Erect and dismantle mobile scaffolds to the manufacturer's instructions, with guardrails and outriggers, after checking the components, base and castors.

tasks.title: Using mobile scaffolds
tasks.task: Use mobile scaffolds: daily checks, castors locked, move with no one on it, keep clear of edges, penetrations and power lines, and safe working loads.

tasks.title: Using ladders (step, platform and extension)
tasks.task: Using ladders (step, platform and extension): choose and inspect the ladder, set it up, keep three points of contact, use platform ladders for work and extension ladders for access only, and non-conductive ladders near electricity.

tasks.title: Manual handling
tasks.task: Manual handling: plan heavy and awkward lifts, use mechanical aids first, team lifts with one person in charge, move materials into place at the work face, and move plant into position.
leaveOut: Load panels onto the floors and move them to the work face
gaps: planning heavy and awkward lifts and team lifts

tasks.title: Forklifts and telehandlers
tasks.task: Operate forklifts and telehandlers: licensed operators, pre-start checks, separate people from forklift routes, check slab loads, and telehandler load charts and attachments.

tasks.title: Pallet jacks, electric pallet jacks and walkie stackers
tasks.task: Pallet jacks and walkie stackers: move plant and materials with pallet jacks, check load limits, slab edges and ramps, and keep feet clear.
gaps: using pallet jacks and walkie stackers

tasks.title: Power tools, including explosive powered tools
tasks.task: Use power tools: inspect and tag tools, guards in place, grinders and cut-off saws, drills, nail guns, and explosive powered tools with spotters and signs, with noise and silica dust controls.

tasks.title: Working at heights: harnesses, travel restraint and fall arrest
tasks.task: Working at heights: install the anchors and static lines and the edge protection, safety nets, harness checks, fall clearance and the rescue plan.
gaps: choosing and checking harnesses, fall clearance and the rescue plan
